sources.title: lemonade-sdk · PyPI
sources.snippet: Lemonade supports GGUF, FLM, and ONNX models across CPU, GPU, and NPU (see supported configurations). Use lemonade-server pull or the built-in Model Manager to download models.

sources.title: Router Policies (collection.router) | lemonade-sdk/lemonade | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: The collection.router system provides a programmable, model-agnostic routing layer within Lemonade. It allows developers to define policies that dynamically select the best inference model for a given request based on content, metadata, or LLM-driven classification.

sources.title: Lemonade API - Lemonade Server Documentation
sources.snippet: Lemonade Server is a lightweight, open-source local LLM server that allows you to run and manage multiple AI applications on your local machine. It provides a simple CLI for managing applications and supports various LLMs, making it easy to deploy and use AI models locally.

sources.title: lemonade-sdk · GitHub
sources.snippet: Lemonade Server is the flagship repo that ties everything together. llamacpp-rocm is our build system for llama.cpp ROCm that uses TheRock. marketplace is where you can submit apps for inclusion on the Lemonade app and website. lemonade-eval is a benchmarking and accuracy evaluation client for Lemonade Server.

sources.title: Multi-Model Support - Lemonade Server Documentation
sources.snippet: This is intentionally independent from both ModelType and the backend's hardware slot policy: A router LLM remains an LLM; it is not reclassified as a classification model. Standard pools continue to use max_loaded_models per ModelType. Routing-helper capacity is keyed by the distinct helper model rather than by ModelType.
